projects.name: Personal Agent OS
projects.privacy: Store durable development metadata only; never store credentials or raw private history.

projects.name: HR GUI
projects.privacy: Never ingest or transmit live HR data, OCR text, local configuration, or employee artifacts.

projects.name: AutoClick
projects.privacy: Never read or index config.json, browser profiles, logs, credentials, or authenticated session data.

projects.name: Job Applicant Dashboard
projects.privacy: Never read or index applicant records, spreadsheets, databases, resumes, drafts, email archives, backups, caches, credentials, or local configuration.

projects.name: OvertimeParser
projects.privacy: Never read or index payroll exports, employee rosters, overtime databases, generated reports, or employee-level output.

projects.name: TES Tagger
projects.privacy: Never read or index API keys, local settings, uploaded game files, or generated book databases unless the user explicitly scopes them in.

projects.name: ScanRenamer
projects.privacy: Treat future scanned documents and extracted text as private local data unless the user explicitly defines a safe boundary.
